about: Worked examples for the AI scorecard reader: real photos checked by a person digit by digit, with the right answer. Sent with every read so the AI learns how these scorebooks are filled in. README: How the AI reader learns -> Worked examples.

examples.checked_by: Claude, from the photo, 2026-11-06 (Heartlake page, Scarborough Pro vs Heartlake 27 Jul 2025)
lessons: INNINGS OF says who batted on THIS page ('HEARTLAKE (2nd)' = Heartlake, inning_number 2), even when that team is written first in PLAYED BETWEEN.
Copy each batter's scribbles into ball_by_ball: a stroke '|' is 1, digits are runs. This scorer writes almost no dots, so balls faced are unknown: balls null.
'not' in HOW OUT with 'out' in the BOWLER column is NOT OUT (Roy, King) - never retired out or run out.
TOTAL numbers like '00', '07', '03' are 0, 7, 3. The batters' TOTALs (136) + extras (24) = the G. TOTAL (160).
HOW OUT can be spelled differently from the bowling list (MERWIN in How out = Marvin in the list): use the bowling list name for both.
Overs per bowler = boxes with marks in the BOWLING ANALYSIS; wickets come from the batting BOWLER column (Marvin 2, Rakesh 3, Manveer 2, Rich 1, Fabian 1).
CAPTS. HOME / VISIT names the captains (here CHECKLEY for Heartlake; a crossed-out name doesn't count): match.captains by team.

examples.checked_by: Claude, from the photo, 2026-11-07 (Amit CC page, Heartlake vs Amit CC 16 Jun 2024; live card aefcc3e5)
lessons: Runs per over are written under each bowling box (Sam 5, 7, 11, 6, 14, 6, 9): copy them into over_runs; runs_conceded is their sum (58) and overs is how many there are (7).
The 3rd bowler is RAVI, not Rams: read each bowler's name in the BOWLING list, never copy a name from another row.
'AMIT 11' in PLAYED BETWEEN and 'AMIT CC' in INNINGS OF are the same team: use the INNINGS OF name.
Run out with a name in the BOWLER column: that name is the fielder, not the bowler (no wicket for him).
A batter with an empty BOWLER cell after 'Caught' (Vishnu) has bowler null - never guess one.
CAPTS. HOME / VISIT give the captains (Amit S, Chuckley); 'AMIT CC WON' in NOTES is the result.
Printed scorecards: copy every number exactly; How out 'c Shah b Khan' = caught, fielder Shah, bowler Khan.
'c & b Singh' is caught and bowled: type 'caught and bowled', fielder AND bowler = Singh (never 'c Singh b Singh' written as two people).
'run out (Ali)' has a fielder and no bowler; 'Did not bat' names are listed with runs null.
Check the card against itself: bowlers' runs = total - byes - leg byes; bowlers' overs = innings overs; each bowler's wickets = batters out to him.
Read HOW OUT, BOWLER and the score on the SAME row as the batter - never shift them to the next batter.
A circled number in the BOWLER column is a shirt number: find it beside a name in the bowling list.
In the bowling boxes a circled corner number is the bowler's running runs; LB / BOW / CT / ST are wickets; plain W is a wide.
Overs = boxes used. Use null for numbers you can't work out.
Runs come from the TOTAL column at the right of each row, not the scribbles and not the batting-order numbers on the left.
Extras boxes are tallies: '11111' = 5 and '21' = 3.
The grand total is the last number in the over-by-over score column when there is no G. TOTAL.
A bowler can be written above the BOWLER heading ('9. TONY') - include him.
